zh-Hant.aiSummaryConfirmed: AI 整理，已由作者確認
zh-Hant.whatHappened: 發生了什麼，讓你有這樣的感受？
zh-Hant.oneSentence: 一句話就可以。你可以在發布前確認 AI 的整理。
zh-Hant.lifeDescription: 住宿、飲食、交通、醫療與第一次獨自在台灣生活的各種意外。
zh-Hant.cultureDescription: 教授、同學、語氣、社交與你不確定怎麼理解的時刻。
zh-Hant.anonymousNote: 預設匿名；發布前可以選擇改用暱稱或真名。學校和帳號不會公開。
zh-Hant.askAiToOrganize: 下一步：請 AI 整理重點
zh-Hant.reviewTitle: AI 幫你保留了原話，也整理了情境。
zh-Hant.reviewNote: 這不是唯一答案，只是讓下一位學生更容易理解你的經驗。
zh-Hant.exploreNote: 不是誰比較正確，而是不同情境下可能有不同感受與做法。
zh-Hant.actionHomeNote: 依官方資料與近期學生執行回饋持續更新
zh-Hant.completionDifferentDetail: 告訴我們哪個部分不同。
zh-Hant.completionFailedDetail: 分享流程在哪一步停止。
zh-Hant.feedbackHelpsNext: 你的回饋能幫助下一位學生。
zh-Hant.feedbackThanks: 謝謝，你的執行紀錄已準備送交審核。
zh-Hant.signInWithGoogle: 使用 Google 帳號登入
zh-Hant.signInNeeded: 登入後才能使用這個功能。瀏覽不需要登入。
zh-Hant.networkError: 連不上伺服器，請檢查網路後重試。
zh-Hant.genericError: 出了點問題，請稍後再試。
zh-Hant.aiUnavailable: AI 整理暫時無法使用，你的原話已保存為草稿，請稍後再試。
zh-Hant.aiDailyLimit: 今天的 AI 整理次數已用完，明天再試。
zh-Hant.rateLimited: 太頻繁了，請稍等一下再試。
zh-Hant.reportSent: 已收到檢舉，管理者會審查。
zh-Hant.alreadyReported: 你已經檢舉過這則經驗。
zh-Hant.blockConfirm: 封鎖後，你不會再看到這位作者用同樣身分（匿名或具名）發的經驗和留言。對方不會知道。
zh-Hant.deleteAccountConfirm: 這會永久刪除你的帳號、分享的經驗、反應、收藏、辦理紀錄與助理對話，無法復原。
zh-Hant.notVerifiedNote: 這是學生的個人經驗，不是官方規定。
zh-Hant.startedNewer: 這個流程已有新版本；你目前依照開始時的版本辦理。
zh-Hant.noRecentCompletions: 近 30 天還沒有學生回報完成。
zh-Hant.recentStuck: 位學生最近在這一步卡關
zh-Hant.feedbackSubmitted: 謝謝，你的回報已送交審核。
zh-Hant.publishedNotice: 已匿名發布，謝謝你的分享。
zh-Hant.summaryOutdated: 你改過原話，請重新請 AI 整理。
zh-Hant.devLoginNote: 開發模式：輸入名字即可登入（只在開發環境有效）。
zh-Hant.noProgressYet: 你還沒有開始辦理流程。
zh-Hant.respondingTo: 你正在分享和另一則經驗不同的經驗。
zh-Hant.noSaved: 還沒有收藏。看到想再看的經驗，按書籤圖示就會存在這裡。
zh-Hant.savedNotice: 已收藏，可以在「我的」找到。
zh-Hant.aiOrganizeHelp: AI 會把你的原話整理成「情境」「感受」和「給下一位學生的提醒」，讓其他學生更快看懂、搜尋得到，也會自動翻成英文。整理完你可以修改，確認後才會發布，你的原話也會一起保留。
zh-Hant.needNameHint: 想用暱稱或真名發布，先到「我的」→「個人資料」填寫。
zh-Hant.realNameWarning: 用真名發布時，所有人都看得到你的真名。
zh-Hant.namesNote: 都可以不填。只有你發文時選擇用暱稱或真名，才會顯示在那則經驗上；之後改名或清空，已發布的經驗也會跟著更新。

en.understand: What are you adjusting to in Taiwan?
en.aiSummaryConfirmed: AI summary, confirmed by the author
en.whatHappened: What happened, and how did it make you feel?
en.oneSentence: One sentence is enough. You can review the AI draft before publishing.
en.lifeDescription: Housing, food, transport, healthcare, and the unexpected parts of living in Taiwan for the first time.
en.cultureDescription: Professors, classmates, tone, social situations, and moments that are hard to interpret.
en.anonymousNote: Anonymous by default; before publishing you can choose to sign with your nickname or real name. Your school and account are never shown.
en.reviewTitle: AI kept your original voice and organized the situation.
en.reviewNote: This is not one correct answer. It helps the next student understand your experience.
en.exploreNote: No one is more correct. Different situations can lead to different feelings and choices.
en.actionHomeTitle: Complete your next task with confidence.
en.actionHomeNote: Updated through official information and recent student feedback
en.incompleteAria: not complete, click to mark complete
en.completionDifferentDetail: Tell us which part was different.
en.feedbackHelpsNext: Your feedback helps the next student.
en.feedbackThanks: Thanks. Your execution record is ready to be reviewed.
en.signInNeeded: Sign in to use this. Browsing doesn't need an account.
en.networkError: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
en.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
en.aiUnavailable: AI organizing is unavailable right now. Your words are saved as a draft; try again later.
en.aiDailyLimit: You've used today's AI organizing limit. Try again tomorrow.
en.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
en.reportSent: Thanks. A reviewer will look at it.
en.blockConfirm: You won't see posts or comments this author shares under the same identity (anonymous or named) again. They won't be notified.
en.deleteAccountConfirm: This permanently deletes your account, shared experiences, reactions, saved experiences, procedure progress and assistant conversations. It can't be undone.
en.noShares: You haven't shared an experience yet.
en.notVerifiedNote: This is a student's personal experience, not an official rule.
en.startedNewer: A newer version of this procedure exists; you're following the version you started.
en.noRecentCompletions: No completions reported in the last 30 days.
en.notYetVerified: Not yet verified against official sources
en.feedbackSubmitted: Thanks. Your report was sent for review.
en.publishedNotice: Published anonymously. Thank you for sharing.
en.summaryOutdated: You changed your words; ask the AI to organize them again.
en.devLoginNote: Development mode: enter a name to sign in (works only in development).
en.noProgressYet: You haven't started a procedure yet.
en.respondingTo: You're sharing an experience that differs from another one.
en.noSaved: Nothing saved yet. Tap the bookmark on an experience to keep it here.
en.savedNotice: Saved. You can find it under My.
en.aiOrganizeHelp: The AI turns your words into a short situation, feeling and a tip for the next student, so others can understand and find it quickly, and it is translated automatically. You can edit it, nothing is published until you confirm, and your original words are kept.
en.needNameHint: To sign with a nickname or real name, add it first under My → Your names.
en.realNameWarning: Signing with your real name shows it to everyone.
en.namesNote: Both are optional. A name only appears on experiences you choose to sign with it; renaming or clearing it later updates those experiences too.
en.welcomeTitle: Welcome! What should we call you?
